findings.finding: The official form for this family is CC-1203, and the PF01 assignment table named CC-1201.
findings.consequence: PF01 assigned CC-1201. CC-1201's Section C accepts an ancillary matter only as an addition to a charge or conviction listed on its page 1, so an ancillary-matter-only petition cannot be expressed on it at all; CC-1203 Section B is exactly this route and asks for the already-sealed offence rather than a charge to seal. The track's recorded authority in data/rcap-ledger/track-pathway-crosswalk.json is § 19.2-392.12:1(B) and (J). The family is built on CC-1203 and this discrepancy is the lane's principal finding.

findings.finding: CC-1201 gives one widget name to as many as four different boxes, and four of its widgets carry a reversed /Rect.
findings.consequence: Every row in this map is keyed by widget name plus the measured coordinate, and every rectangle is normalized before a caption is checked against it.

findings.finding: The widget names on both forms do not describe the blanks. `User.DateOfArrest` is the ancillary matter's arrest date on CC-1201, and `User.CityOrCounty` is the deciding court's city while the shared field semantics binds that name to participant.city.
findings.consequence: Every caption was read off the page at the widget's own coordinates, and every name-channel binding that would have written the wrong fact is refused by role.

findings.finding: The petitioner's city, state and ZIP is one printed box, and the field-semantics descriptor the widget name binds to is participant.city.
findings.consequence: The fixture carries the whole city, state and ZIP line under participant.city. This is a field-semantics fidelity note, recorded rather than worked around: the value written matches the box the court printed.

findings.finding: 24 blanks across this packet are facts the platform does not hold.
findings.consequence: Every one is declared REQUIRED_BEFORE_FILING and named in participant-instructions.md by the words printed beside it.

findings.finding: The finalizer refuses a checkbox by type, which is right for a fact map and wrong for a route election.
findings.consequence: Route elections are marked after flattening, with two diagonals struck inside the box the court already printed, and each mark is read back out of the output bytes as a painted path inside its own measured box.
